reviews.comment: Final exam class average was a 54 with the final exam being 40% of the grade. The final was 8 questions over 2 hours and introduced new topics never taught before. For reference, the average MECH exam in our school is 3 questions for 2 hours. His teaching style is reading off the power point and not doing any practice problems

Had nearly a 100 and good understanding of the material going into the final exam (made a 99 on lab). The final exam was about 8 hours worth of problems crammed into 2 hours and was 40% of the final grade. Prof promised he would give a comprehensive equation sheet, which ended up missing 90% of the needed equations. There was no path to success.

Came to lecture with notes already written out, which he scrolled through too fast to write down or understand; as well as containing errors, unreadable handwriting, and confusing notation. They were not available outside of lecture. The final exam worth 40% of the grade was an impossible task, regardless of the understanding of the content.

Nice person, taught myself the entire class. Doesnt post notes unless hounded, and incredibly test heavy. Midterms aren't computationally hard, know the material and its fine. Had a 96 with exams and hw however its completely pointless when he gives a 40% final from satan himself. Class was laughing mid exam from how ridiculous it was. Good luck

Great person. Bad professor. Did not follow the textbook in lecture, did not post lecture notes to canvas, and handwrote them on his Ipad beforehand then sprinted through them every lecture. Only professor not to allow a cheat sheet on exams either. This class is hard, he made it unnecessarily harder. Do not take his class for MEEN 364

Not sure how well this guy understands what he teaches.  Notes aren't posted unless requested, they are handwritten, and riddled with errors.  Cannot trust a resource posted on Canvas.  Doesn't follow a textbook to read up on your own.  Thankfully the TA was good, he was the only reason I passed the exams.  Final is 40% of your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The professor conveys concepts in a very intuitive and physical manner, which helps students grasp the concept quickly and help them remember the same. The concepts he taught in class, which are fundamental robotics concepts, are very powerful and practically useful. He conveyed the same with very strong examples in class.

Dr. Darbha is very unique in the way he goes about course. Most of the material covered, aren't in regular books and very well presented. Ask him doubts after class and he'd spend the whole day with you if necessary. 100% will take again.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: don't care what people say but he goes out of his way to help you if he sees you're sincere and working hard. he's very kind and does his best to help all of his students. he's one of the best profs I've ever had. those who don't do well in his class either don't give their full effort or complain. 100% would recommend his class!!

Amazing prof. Very genuine, and has a very unique approach to the material explained in a way where you can understand the material. He is a wonderful person and works hard to help his students be successful. HIGHLY RECOMMEND TAKING HIS CLASS.

The class material was not as difficult as the professor made it. I tried throughout the semester to ask questions and ask for examples both in class and over email but each time he ignored my request. We also had three exams total, including the final, and each one was written either the morning of the exam or the day before. DO NOT TAKE HIM!!!
